name: reelclaw
description: Make TikTok/Reels/Shorts UGC ads for the product in your repo with real human reaction hooks from DansUGC, or with your own footage. Your agent sets up one local reel project with the open-source reelclaw engine (7 viral templates and the reelclaw-playbook skill: brief, hooks, footage, music, frame-by-frame QA, variants), edits and renders every reel on your machine, and checks each render before delivering. The dansugc MCP server supplies clips, viral-format suggestions, trending music, research and posting; it does not render. No API keys: log in with your DansUGC account (OAuth). Works on any DansUGC account, no plan needed; editing and rendering are free and local, you pay only for clips you don't own yet and research queries.
